title: Skill Frontmatter
description: Internal schema for the YAML frontmatter at the top of each SKILL.md. Top level matches the open Agent Skills standard (see schemas/agent-skills.schema.json, vendorized snapshot); the 5 proprietary aiadev pipeline fields (version, inputs, outputs, requires, handoffs) are nested under metadata.aiadev instead of living at the top level (spec 0016 Story 1, cl-1, cl-7).

name.description: Unique skill identifier in kebab-case. Must match the containing directory name.

description.description: One-line summary used by agents to decide when to invoke the skill.

license.description: Optional attribution line when the skill is adapted from another project. Primary attribution still lives in CREDITS.md.

compatibility.description: Optional 1-500 char string describing environment requirements (intended product, system packages, network access). Per the open Agent Skills standard.

metadata.description: Open map for additional metadata. Third parties may add any other key/value here; aiadev nests its own pipeline fields under the single namespaced key `aiadev`.

aiadev.description: aiadev pipeline metadata, namespaced to avoid collisions with other frameworks. All keys optional.

version.description: Semver. Optional during v0.1; required from v0.2.

requires.description: Other skill names, file paths, or artifacts this skill expects to exist.

handoffs.description: Skill names this skill typically invokes next. Non-binding; `implement` does not rely on handoffs to route.

allowed-tools.description: Restrict which tools the skill may call. Optional. Kept tolerant of both shapes (string or array) since existing consumer skills use either.

disable-model-invocation.description: If true, the skill never runs the model — it is a deterministic script. Runtime extension read from the top level (spec 0016 cl-7).

argument-hint.description: Shown in UIs that prompt the user for arguments before invoking the skill. Runtime extension read from the top level (spec 0016 cl-7).
